harness_entry.name: benchmark — multi-turn KV offload (kv-offload-lab)
harness_entry.invoke: bash -lc 'set -a; source "$ROOT_DIR/kv-offload-lab/.env"; set +a; bash "$ROOT_DIR/kv-offload-lab/benchmark/multi-turn/run_benchmark.sh" --workload sharegpt --policy evolved --gpu-util 0.5 --num-clients 4 --max-active 128 --kv-size 26'

output_template.notes: The benchmark wrapper writes a single JSON document with two nested groups: top-level metrics.* are kv-offload eviction/hit-rate stats and ratios; metrics.metrics.* are the serving-side throughput and latency numbers. When multiple matches exist on disk the runner picks the most recently modified file.

harness_entry.comparison_guidance:
Compare against the baseline best_program_info.json captured for the policy under test before the change.
  - Pass when combined_score is >= baseline (within 1% noise band) AND ttft_ratio <= baseline * 1.05 AND throughput_ratio >= baseline * 0.98 AND failures == 0.
  - Investigate when cpu_hit_rate or engine_external_prefix_hit_rate drops by more than 3 absolute points: that usually means an eviction-policy regression, not a perf regression — cross-check eviction_rate and lookup_misses.
  - Mean/p99 ttft_ms and mean_request_latency_ms are absolute numbers; report deltas in ms and as percentage of baseline. p99_ttft_ms regressing >10% is a hard fail even if the mean looks OK.
  - request_throughput and output_token_throughput should be considered together: a gain in request throughput at the cost of a >5% drop in output_token_throughput usually means shorter outputs were generated and the comparison is invalid.
harness_entry._comment: Paths in this entry are resolved against $ROOT_DIR, which run_validation.sh exports (--root-dir flag or ROOT_DIR env var). HF cache (HF_HOME/HF_HUB_CACHE/TRANSFORMERS_CACHE) is exported by run_validation.sh and inherited here, so the invoke no longer sets it inline. Stand-alone command line (run from $ROOT_DIR/kv-offload-lab with HF_HOME/HF_HUB_CACHE/TRANSFORMERS_CACHE already set): set -a; source .env; set +a; bash benchmark/multi-turn/run_benchmark.sh --workload sharegpt --policy evolved --gpu-util 0.5 --num-clients 4 --max-active 128 --kv-size 26. The invoke wraps the call in 'bash -lc' so the runner (which uses shlex.split + no shell) still gets a shell that expands $ROOT_DIR and sources kv-offload-lab/.env. Flags: --workload sharegpt selects the ShareGPT multi-turn conversation trace; --policy evolved uses the evolved KV offload eviction policy; --gpu-util 0.5 caps vLLM GPU memory utilization at 50% to force offloading; --num-clients 4 issues 4 concurrent client streams; --max-active 128 caps active sequences at 128; --kv-size 26 sets the host-side KV offload pool to 26 GiB.

workloads.description: Decode under memory pressure: 128 concurrent requests with 16K KV cache per request, intentionally exceeding GPU VRAM to trigger KV offload eviction and reload. Agentic multi-turn workload: sequences of short decode steps interleaved with tool calls, modelling ReAct or function-calling patterns. KV blocks from earlier turns must be retained across multiple short generations. Validates that the LRU/ARC eviction policy does not prematurely evict blocks needed for active multi-turn sessions under concurrent load.
